The [[Lizard Warrior]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], used individually unique '''weapons''' that consisted of a long, thin, [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] stick and a [[Rope/Legends|rope]] looped around the stick. It was used to capture beings that intruded into the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians']] territory, the [[Valley of the Lizard Warriors]], and keep the interloper from escaping. The stick was a relatively close-range weapon that worked well during an ambush. Once the enemy was snagged, the rope pulled tight around their body, allowing the weapon's user to control the captive, for example to force them to march.<ref name="E4" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which includes the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 4|''Ewoks'' 4]], to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the Lizard Warriors captured the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], who had wandered into the Valley of the Lizard Warriors. The reptilians then marched the Ewoks to meet [[Graak (lawbreaker)/Legends|Graak]], an [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|outcast]] Ewok and the leader of the Lizard Warriors.<ref name="E4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The weapon appeared in [[Ewoks (1985) 4|''Ewoks'' 4]], the fourth issue of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]], illustrated by [[Warren Kremer]],<ref name="E4" /> and published on [[July 30]], [[1985]].<ref name="MA31">''[[Marvel Age]]'' #31</ref>
